note: Quotas per plan (docs/usage-metering-20261115.md). With metering switched on, the deployment config names one plan (inference.metering.plan, default alpha) and these numbers replace the allowance and the per-feature daily limits written in the deployment config. A cap of 0 switches that feature off for the plan. The alpha uses one plan for everyone. free and premium are proposals for launch, not decided.
